title: Antique Brass Adjustable Height Freestanding Makeup Mirror - 8-Inch Double-Sided 2X/1X Solid Brass, Allied Brass
body_html:
Finished in Antique Brass, get a clearer, steadier view for daily makeup and shaving at your bathroom vanity—backed by a lifetime warranty, which features a softened, aged golden patina that brings vintage charm and character to traditional spaces. This freestanding, adjustable-height make-up mirror features double-sided glass with 2X magnification on one side and 1X on the other for quick, confident grooming.

  • Antique Brass brings warm, timeless elegance
  • Choose from 25 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Keep your counter stable and uncluttered with a freestanding design (no wall mounting)
  • Enjoy a steadier setup—the heavy solid brass base helps prevent tipping
  • Protect your vanity surface with a felt pad that helps prevent scratching

Solid brass construction outlasts die-cast zinc and plastic alternatives, making this mirror a lasting addition to traditional bathroom hardware, classic bath accessories, and heritage bathroom fixtures.

Specs

  • - Product type: Freestanding double-sided make-up mirror
  • - Mirror diameter: 8 Inch
  • - Magnification: 2X on one side; 1X on the opposite side
  • - Dimensions (L x H x W): 10.5 x 56-68 x 10.5 in
  • - Material: Brass (solid brass materials)
  • - Style: Traditional
  • - Assembly: Some assembly required
  • - Included items: Make-up mirror
  • - Warranty: Lifetime warranty
  • - Assembly location: Assembled in the U.S.A.

Complete your bathroom with matching pieces from Allied Brass.
meta_description: Freestanding make-up mirror with 8-inch double-sided glass (2X/1X) and adjustable height. Solid brass construction, traditional style, lifetime warranty.
